page.layout: One printed title page, centred. Title block at the top, a small printer's device (woodcut) in the middle, publisher's imprint in lines at the bottom.
page.notes: The scan is rotated, and the lines appear partly as show-through from the reverse side, so many words are doubtful. Only the title lines are reasonably legible. The lower publisher lines and the name lines are largely illegible and are marked as such rather than guessed. The central image is a small printer's device or woodcut, not transcribed. Library marks ("109-1453", "Rara", the oval stamp with "2") and the pencil shelf mark are excluded as not printed matter.
